statement: zero residue: no ignored runtime state was written into the repository by this run

demonstration.how: clean subject: the step run on the tree before the suite prints no ignored runtime path. Planted violation: the same argv, at the same step, after touching one ignored runtime path by hand, prints it. The observer was watched failing before its silence was quoted.

what_actually_happened: the flag is the whole difference. The same step with --untracked-files=all is silent in both directions, so its silence carries nothing; with --ignored=matching it distinguishes them, so this silence is a NO.
